futures_open_interest.basis: The existing licensed Databento batch and provider already preserve statistics timestamps; the current decoder filters statistics to settlement and cleared volume and can be extended to stat_type 9 without new acquisition.
futures_open_interest.pit_boundary: Use publication/capture timestamp as availability and ts_ref as statistic reference date; keep the last eligible publication at or before the decision timestamp.
futures_open_interest.caveat: Pre-2017 legacy FIX/FAST timestamps are exchange-sourced rather than independently captured and must remain explicitly flagged in lineage.

options_implied.basis: ON and LNE have documented 2010-06-06 history with Definition and Statistics, including IV and delta statistic types. Existing project rights cover already-purchased historical material, but the repository has not proven that the purchased batch contains the required option products/strikes or that reacquisition is free.
allowed_now: zero-dollar provider cost quote or metadata request
options_implied.activation_gate: Require actual 2010-2022 strike/expiry depth, PIT timestamp semantics, local or approved acquisition identity, and acceptable cost before feature scoring.

storage_consensus_surprise.basis: Repository discovery identifies Bloomberg as the preferred source-faithful route and public evidence shows analyst surveys existed, but no complete licensed timestamped 2010-2022 consensus archive is registered or acquired.
storage_consensus_surprise.rule: Do not substitute seasonal storage anomaly, a model forecast, isolated public articles, or post-release commentary for pre-release market consensus.
storage_consensus_surprise.revisit_trigger: A reproducible 2010-2022 pre-release consensus archive with publication timestamps and private-research rights is acquired and integrity-audited.

eia_event_timing.basis: The official EIA release schedule supplies the recurring clock and the repository already owns holiday/revision-aware WNGSR availability semantics.
eia_event_timing.execution_boundary: Features become usable only after public release and at a strategy-executable decision timestamp; no same-instant/HFT fill assumption.

volatility_tail_specialists.basis: #448 defines required specialist/state interfaces; model-family fitting belongs to #427 and conditional admission/confidence/risk roles to #428/#430.

decision: Proceed with technical, market-structure/OI and event-timing implementation; keep true storage surprise on HOLD; perform options zero-spend feasibility only and do not let it block V2.
protected_evidence_statement: No confirmation, prospective paper, SIM, LIVE, or post-2022 outcome evidence was inspected to make these source decisions.
supersession_reason: No-scoring full-history preflight resolved actual nested OI coverage and justified the preregistered availability-aligned OI evaluation lane before empirical scoring.
